data.spec: Fixing concrete missed notification transitions: feedback polling currently can lose quick order→resolved and facility active→recovered changes. Add internal bus.add_listener(callback, *, source) -> unsubscribe; bus.publish(event,data,*,source=None) retains same SSE shape and synchronously notifies only listeners bound to identical source object. Feedback service registers with source=SQLite connection for app lifespan; scoped task.updated/requests.updated/state.changed/facility.updated capture immediately (read-only current durable state -> INSERT OR IGNORE feed), watcher remains recovery. No frontend/contract schema changes. Minimal publishers get source=conn. Facility-backend-dispatch owner: please add source=self.conn to facility.updated/state.changed/requests.updated and source=conn in _task_update; do not edit feedback.py/bus.py. Also fixing atomic pending WhatsApp claim and suppress recovered/stale facility prompts before send.
